references.text: Previous instruction on the distribution of the land by casting lots, where larger tribes receive a larger inheritance and smaller tribes receive a smaller one.
The fulfillment of this command when the tribes of Israel received their inheritance in the land of Canaan by casting lots.
Joshua cast lots for the tribes at Shiloh before the Lord, as commanded in 4 Mosebok.
Conclusion of the distribution of the land by casting lots, carried out by Joshua, Eleazar, and the heads of the tribes.
Casting lots as a method to determine the will of the Lord, the principle behind the allocation of inheritances.
Ezekiel's prophecy about the future distribution of the land among the tribes of Israel as an inheritance.
Paul refers to how God distributed the land of Canaan as an inheritance to the people of Israel.
